name: Coherence web
postStartCommand: cd coherence/web && (npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo "BUILD_EXIT:$?" >> /tmp/build.log) ; (nohup npm start -- -p 3000 > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo "server launch attempted") ; cd /tmp && (nohup python3 -m http.server 3001 > /tmp/httplog.txt 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo 'log server on 3001')
